parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of unittest.TestCase.tearDown being executed on skipped tests when running with --pdb. The changes are minimal and focused on the problem area.

issues.description: The patch introduces a new attribute '_skipped' to the item object, which could potentially lead to maintainability issues if not handled consistently across the codebase.
